# Remote (in-container) deps for safety/modal_safety_test on Modal.
# Pared down from the pins used for the local replication: dropped the vLLM/Together
# judge stack (litellm, python-dotenv), the CE-loss data stack (datasets, pandas,
# zstandard), plots (matplotlib), and pipeline-only typing (jaxtyping, typeguard,
# transformers-stream-generator). What remains loads a HF causal-LM, runs harness.py
# + steering_primitives.py, and the HarmBench classifier.
#
# transformers 4.51.3 supports the Qwen3 family (anchor: Qwen3-14B) as well as the
# Qwen2-family DeepSeek-R1-Distill models. huggingface-hub bumped to 0.30.2 to satisfy
# 4.51 (was 4.44.2 / hub 0.23.3 for the DeepSeek-only debug phase). tokenizers is left
# unpinned so the resolver picks the 0.21.x that 4.51 requires. smoke() (CPU, ~$0)
# validates the resolved set before any GPU dollar.

# --- core: model + steering + harness ---
torch==2.3.0
transformers==4.51.3
accelerate==0.31.0
safetensors==0.4.3
huggingface-hub==0.30.2
sentencepiece==0.2.0
protobuf==5.27.1
numpy==1.26.4           # harness.py

# --- tokenizer/runtime insurance for the Qwen family ---
tiktoken==0.7.0
einops==0.8.0

# --- misc ---
tqdm==4.66.4
